desc:
Catch magical creatures, hatch their eggs, and raise companions on your own island!

✨ Use your wand to catch wild creatures, from horses and wolves to elusive dragons.
🥚 Bring eggs home, hatch them in your incubators, and grow your collection.
💛 Brush, feed, and pet your companions.
🧹 Explore on a flying broom, ride ground mounts, and take to the skies with flying creatures.
🌍 Discover Verdant Wilds, Ember Highlands, and the moonlit world of Moonveil as you level up.
🌙 Find different coats and rare mutations, and earn Moon Coins along the way.

Your next companion is waiting. Begin your magical journey!

Early access — we’re continuing to improve the game and add new adventures. Help us improve the game with your feedback.
